reasons.plausibility: The proposed grain-boundary segregation and local short-range ordering as a cause of embrittlement is well-documented in analogous alloy systems, making it scientifically sound for high-entropy alloys.
reasons.testability: They provide a clear experimental plan with controlled conditions, direct measurements (APT, fracture tests), and a decisive falsification outcome.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a direct way to probe a key failure mechanism in HEAs under service conditions, thus providing valuable insights for engineering design and alloy development.
